explanation: The patch keeps the parent task runner alive for worker cleanup, but outbound message tasks still look up a task runner by the disposed parent isolate. A late transferred ArrayBuffer can therefore keep its backing store alive past V8::Dispose.
verification: Rebuilt out/x64.asan/d8 with gn and ninja. The probe triggered an AddressSanitizer heap-use-after-free in ArrayBufferAllocator::Free on the submitted patch. With the upstream message-posting fix applied as well, the same probe exited 0 without ASan output.
